## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (typecheck, lint, format, tests, build)
- [ ] Database tests pass if an adapter changed (`npm run db:up` then `npm run test:ci`)
- [ ] `npm run examples:test` passes if the CLI, Express middleware or packaging changed
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] README and CHANGELOG updated for anything users will notice
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies
- [ ] Commit messages are plain and describe the change
